observations: Photo 0 shows the retail box of a Western Digital (WD) Elements 1TB portable hard drive.
The box is white with the WD logo in orange at the top left.
Text on the box includes 'WD Elements', 'Portable HDD', and '1 TB' in the top right corner.
There is a 3-year limited warranty badge on the bottom right.
The box has a watermark 'POSTED ON JIJI BOLA.O'.
The image shows only the box; the actual hard drive is not visible.

claims.claim: This is a 1TB external hard drive
claims.evidence: Photo 0 shows the box labeled '1 TB' and 'WD Elements Portable HDD'.
No photo shows the contents of the drive. The box is sealed and no interface or screen is visible to confirm files.
The claim is cut off and no photo shows any games or their compatibility. No proof of game files or functionality is visible.

risks.risk: The hard drive may be damaged, not functional, or not contain the claimed 26 PS4 games.
risks.proof: A photo of the actual hard drive with its label, and a screenshot or video showing the contents of the drive (file list or game icons) and a test of one game on a PS4.
risks.if_unproven: priced as not working or empty, with no game content

risks.risk: The hard drive may be counterfeit or not genuine WD Elements.
risks.proof: A close-up photo of the actual hard drive showing the WD logo and model label, and possibly a serial number.
risks.if_unproven: priced as unbranded or generic, with lower value

risks.risk: The games may be pirated or illegal, which could lead to legal issues for the buyer.
risks.proof: A screenshot of the game files with their names and file types, and a statement from the seller confirming legal ownership or source.
risks.if_unproven: priced as potentially illegal, with reduced value or no price

proof_requests: Photo of the actual hard drive (not the box) showing the label and model.
Screenshot or video showing the contents of the drive, including the 26 PS4 game files.
Proof that the games are functional (e.g., a video of one game loading on a PS4).
Close-up of the drive's serial number and any warranty sticker.
response.reason: The item is identified as a WD Elements 1TB external hard drive, but the seller's claims about 26 PS4 games are unverifiable from the photo. The actual drive and its contents are not shown, so risks of non-functionality, counterfeit, or illegal content cannot be ruled out. Proof is needed to confirm the drive's condition and the presence and legality of the games.
